device.description: 24-bit bridge-sensor delta-sigma ADC with low-side switch, 10/80 SPS and 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK)
device.note: ads1231.pdf (SBAS414D) p.3-4 electrical characteristics (data rate, logic levels, AVDD/DVDD 3-5.3 V), p.5 pin configuration and descriptions, p.12 data format, data rate, p.13 DRDY/DOUT and data retrieval timing (tPD = 50 ns, tCONV 12.5/100 ms), p.14 standby

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the SPEED pin level (pins.levels); 0 = 10 SPS, 1 = 80 SPS (p.5); no serial registers

pages: p.3-4 (EC), p.5 (pins), p.12 (data format, data rate), p.13 (DRDY/DOUT, retrieval timing), p.14 (standby)
notModeled: conversion time tCONV = 12.5 ms (SPEED = 1) / 100 ms (SPEED = 0) with the internal oscillator (p.13); an external CLKIN (fCLKIN / 61,440 or / 491,520) scales it (CLKIN is not used)
DRDY/DOUT stays at the last data bit until the next update unless an extra SCLK forces it high; modeled as idle 1 after the data bits
standby mode (SCLK held high after DRDY/DOUT falls) and its wake-up
data-update window (no readback) and data overwritten if not read before the next update
PDWN low also resets the ADC (modeled as power-down only; there are no serial registers)
